question:
**Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them contains a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error.**

He is such an untruthful man, that no one will believing him.
solution:
The erroneous part is **'will believing him.'**

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present tense form.**
 
• will believing him * is in the **future tense form** making it incorrect. 
 
• So, **option 1 **is the correct answer. 
 
• Since the subject of the sentence is **third person singular (He)**, we need to use the present tense form **believes **to make the sentence correct. 

**Correct sentence__ - ***He is such an untruthful man, that no one **believes** him.*
